description: Approve one planned Autopilot post. The first call returns the exact post, schedule, native over-cap question and expectedActionHash as a preview; show it to the owner, then confirm the unchanged actionId and expectedActionHash with confirm:true and a stable clientRequestId. Approval may make and publish the post; the native generated payload revision and schedule are checked atomically, and all spending caps and Autopilot settings stay intact. Needs manage:autopilot. After uncertainty read soclo_autopilot_get_draft with the original actionId and reconcile; never repeat the write or create a replacement.
name: soclo_autopilot_approve_draft
title: Approve a planned Autopilot post
